module.name: Platform: Shell, Navigation, Personas & Shared UI

screens.name: Public landing page (الصفحة الرئيسية — منصة منح)
Partner organization registration (تسجيل جهة شريكة / سجّل جهتك)
Persona switcher (demo mode) (وضع العرض — اختر شخصية)
Demo guide panel (دليل العرض — عند من واقف الإجراء؟)
Interactive demo controls bar (وضع العرض التفاعلي)
roles: any persona viewing the demo project

screens.name: Platform admin — workshop deck tab (بوابة الآدمن ← عرض ورشة العمل)
Error page / error boundary (تعذّر تحميل الصفحة)

epics.name: Identity, Session & Access Control
epics.description: Session establishment, login, personas/roles and (recommended) production-grade authentication and authorization.

epics.name: Public Entry & Partner Onboarding
epics.description: Landing page, partner self-registration with registry lookup and OTP, delegate verification, invitation acceptance.

epics.name: Workspace Shell & Navigation
epics.description: Role-based sidebar, header tools, global search, theme/palette, RTL and digit localization.

epics.name: AI Copilot
epics.description: Read-only conversational assistant over tenant data that proposes actions for human confirmation.

epics.name: Demo & Workshop Enablement
epics.description: Contextual demo guide, scripted demo controls and the requirements-workshop deck.

epics.name: Shared UI Framework
epics.description: Reusable list, view-preference, loading/error, guided-dialog and help patterns used by all modules.

features.name: Session establishment & login
features.description: Ensures a Supabase session before rendering; provides a login page (cosmetic in the prototype) and bearer-token authentication for server functions.
acceptance_criteria: No page content renders before a session exists.
Submitting the login form lands the user on their role's home page.
Server functions reject requests without a valid bearer JWT.

features.name: Persona & role model with demo switcher
features.description: Loads personas, keeps a current persona per browser and lets a presenter switch persona; defines role labels and role home pages.
acceptance_criteria: Switching persona updates sidebar, header and lands on the role home.
The selected persona survives a page reload on the same browser.

features.name: Role-based navigation & page gates
features.description: Role-specific sidebar with active-state, grouped sub-routes, open-task badges, header breadcrumb, mobile drawer; page-level gates for /admin, /portal and settings tabs.
acceptance_criteria: Each role sees exactly its configured sidebar items.
Badge counts equal the open items on 'My tasks'.
A non-admin opening /admin sees the restriction message.

features.name: Public landing page
features.description: Hero with calls to action, three capability cards and cards for active grant programs.
acceptance_criteria: Active programs are listed newest first with budget and deadline.
CTAs navigate to /portal and /register-tenant.

features.name: Partner self-registration (license lookup, registry prefill, OTP)
features.description: A partner representative selects an applicant type, looks up the license/ID, completes registry-prefilled fields, verifies contact channels by OTP and submits for platform review.
acceptance_criteria: A new license produces a form prefilled from the registry where available.
Submission is blocked until filled OTP fields are verified.
A successful submission creates a pending entity_registrations row.

features.name: Existing-entity delegate verification & delegate change request
features.description: For an already-registered license, shows masked delegates, lets the user verify affiliation by OTP to the delegate, or request a delegate change for platform review.
roles: public visitor (staff of a registered partner)
acceptance_criteria: Delegates are displayed masked.
A delegate-change request is stored for platform review.

features.name: Invitation acceptance
features.description: Token-based invitation page showing the opportunity, with activate-and-apply, apply, or decline paths.
acceptance_criteria: An unknown token shows 'invalid invitation link'.
First view of a 'sent' invitation sets it to 'opened'.
Proceeding opens the portal application for that program.

features.name: Global search
features.description: Command-palette search across partners, applications, projects/initiatives, payments, programs, plans and staff plus page shortcuts and recent items.
acceptance_criteria: Typing ≥2 characters returns grouped results within the tenant.
Selecting a result navigates and adds it to recent items.

features.name: Theme, palette, RTL & digit localization
features.description: Light/dark mode, three colour palettes, Arabic RTL document with Radix direction provider, Western-digit normalisation.
acceptance_criteria: Theme and palette persist across reloads on the same device.
Eastern Arabic digits never appear in rendered labels.

features.name: AI Copilot (read-only assistant)
features.description: Side-panel chat that answers questions using read-only tools over tenant data and proposes changes as link cards.
acceptance_criteria: Answers use live data from tools.
Any change request yields a link card, never a data write.
Requests without a valid session get 401.

features.name: Contextual demo guide
features.description: Help sheet with page-specific walkthrough steps; on project pages it identifies the pending payment step and the persona to switch to.
acceptance_criteria: On a project with a payment awaiting transfer, the guide proposes the finance persona.
Pages without a guide show a generic hint.

features.name: Scripted demo controls
features.description: Advance/undo/reset a 7-step scenario on the demo project by writing predefined states to the database.
acceptance_criteria: 'Advance' applies the next scripted state and refreshes the page data.
'Reset' returns the project to its initial state.

features.name: Requirements-workshop deck with notes
features.description: 11-slide 16:9 presentation inside /admin with agenda, method, six sessions (goal, points, comparison questions, deep links) and note boxes, a parking lot and a summary.
acceptance_criteria: Arrow keys/space navigate slides when not typing.
Notes typed in a session reappear in the summary slide.

features.name: Data table & saved views
features.description: Reusable list component with search, column chooser, pagination, export and per-user pinned views, plus a secondary-filter popover with chips.
screens: (used by list screens in other modules)
acceptance_criteria: Export contains only visible exportable columns of all filtered rows.
A pinned view is restored on next visit for the same persona.

features.name: Page scaffolding, loading and error handling
features.description: Page container and header, page-shaped skeleton that turns into an error-with-retry, 404 page, root error boundary, telemetry reporting and SSR error capture.
acceptance_criteria: A failed query on a loading page shows 'تعذّر تحميل البيانات' with retry.
Unknown URLs show the 404 page.

features.name: Guided actions, concept help & layout helpers
features.description: SmartFlow step dialog, auto-stepping long dialogs, InfoTip concept glossary, SectionTabs, StatCard (clickable filter), Pill, Field, StageTracker.
acceptance_criteria: SmartFlow shows a stepper only when there is more than one step.
Clicking a StatCard toggles its table filter and shows an active ring.

features.name: Production identity & authorization (recommended)
features.description: Replace the shared demo account and client-side persona with per-user authentication, server-side role/tenant authorization and tenant-scoped RLS.
acceptance_criteria: A user can only read and write rows of their own tenant permitted by their role.
Demo credentials and switchers are absent from production builds.

requirements.statement: The system shall establish an authenticated session before rendering any page.
acceptance_criteria: Given no session, when the app loads, then a loading message shows until a session exists and the page renders.
Given an existing session, when the app loads, then no new sign-in occurs.

requirements.statement: The system shall provide a login page with email and password fields that forwards the user to the home page of the active role.
acceptance_criteria: Given the login page, when the user submits, then they land on their role home.
Given the login page, when the user clicks anywhere, then the demo credentials are filled once.

requirements.statement: The system shall require a valid bearer JWT on authenticated server functions and execute their database calls under the caller's token.
acceptance_criteria: Given a request without Authorization, when a protected server function is called, then it fails with 'Unauthorized'.
Given a valid token, when called, then the function receives userId and a user-scoped client.

requirements.statement: The system shall authenticate each person with individual credentials and bind the session to exactly one user record (persona) per tenant membership.
acceptance_criteria: Given two different users, when they sign in, then each sees only their own persona and role.
Given an unauthenticated visitor, when they open a staff page, then they are redirected to login.

requirements.statement: The system shall enforce tenant isolation and role permissions in database policies and server functions.
acceptance_criteria: Given a reviewer, when they call an update on payments directly, then the database rejects it.
Given a user of tenant A, when they query tenant B rows, then none are returned.

requirements.statement: The system shall exclude demo artefacts (shared credentials, persona switcher, demo guide, demo controls, demo OTP display) from production builds.
acceptance_criteria: Given a production build, when any page loads, then no persona switcher or demo bar is rendered.
Given the production bundle, when inspected, then it contains no hard-coded passwords.

requirements.statement: The system shall load the persona list and maintain a current persona persisted in the browser, defaulting to the first persona.
acceptance_criteria: Given a stored persona id, when the app reloads, then that persona is active.
Given no stored id, when personas load, then the first persona becomes active and is stored.

requirements.statement: The system shall define a display label and a home route for each of the 8 roles.
acceptance_criteria: Given any role, when displayed, then its Arabic label is shown.
Given a persona switch, when completed, then navigation goes to ROLE_HOME of the new role.

requirements.statement: The system shall let the user switch persona from a 'demo mode' menu listing all personas with initials, name, role and current marker.
acceptance_criteria: Given the menu, when a persona is chosen, then it becomes current and the user lands on its home.
Given the menu, when opened, then the current persona shows a check mark.

requirements.statement: The system shall show a sidebar whose items depend on the current role (NAV_BY_ROLE).
acceptance_criteria: Given role reviewer, when the shell renders, then the sidebar shows exactly Data & reports, My tasks, Grant applications, Partner organizations.
Given role project_manager, then only My tasks and Projects are shown.

requirements.statement: The system shall highlight the active sidebar item, including grouped sub-routes, and show its icon and label in the header.
acceptance_criteria: Given /programs/123, when rendered for grants_manager, then 'طلبات المنح' is active.
Given a route not in the role's sidebar, then no item is active and the header label is empty.

requirements.statement: The system shall display open-task count badges on sidebar items.
acceptance_criteria: Given 3 open application tasks, when the sidebar renders, then 'طلبات المنح' shows 3.
Given no open tasks, then no badge is shown.

requirements.statement: The system shall render a header-only layout for public pages and the applicant role.
acceptance_criteria: Given an applicant persona, when any page renders, then no sidebar is shown.
Given /login, when rendered, then login and register buttons appear in the header.

requirements.statement: The system shall provide the sidebar as a slide-in drawer on small screens.
acceptance_criteria: Given a mobile viewport, when the menu button is tapped, then the drawer opens with role items.
Given the drawer, when an item is chosen, then the drawer closes and navigation occurs.

requirements.statement: The system shall restrict the platform admin page (/admin) to the admin role.
acceptance_criteria: Given a grants_manager, when opening /admin, then the restriction message and Team link are shown.
Given admin, when opening /admin, then the tabs render.

requirements.statement: The system shall filter Settings section tabs by platform vs tenant scope.
acceptance_criteria: Given admin, when Settings renders, then 'الجهات والمستخدمون' is shown and 'فريق العمل' is hidden.
Given grants_manager, then the reverse holds.

requirements.statement: The system shall show a landing page with hero text, calls to action and three capability cards.
acceptance_criteria: Given the landing page, when 'تصفح برامج المنح' is clicked, then /portal opens.
Given the landing page, then three capability cards are shown.

requirements.statement: The system shall list active grant programs on the landing page with title, description, budget and deadline.
acceptance_criteria: Given two active programs, when the landing renders, then both appear newest first.
Given a closed program, then it is not listed.

requirements.statement: The system shall let the representative choose an applicant type from the portal-enabled, open types of the tenant.
acceptance_criteria: Given the tenant closed 'company', when the page loads, then the 'شركة' chip is absent.
Given 'فرد' is chosen, then the ID placeholder reads 'رقم الهوية الوطنية / الإقامة'.

requirements.statement: The system shall look up the entered license/ID and classify it as registered, pending or new.
acceptance_criteria: Given license 1234, when 'تحقق' is pressed, then the registered card is shown.
Given a license with a pending request, then the masked applicant name and mobile are shown.

requirements.statement: The system shall prefill registration fields from the official registry and mark each field's provenance.
acceptance_criteria: Given license 7781, when looked up, then name, unified number, region, city, classification, phone and delegate name are prefilled and tagged 'من السجل'.
Given a prefilled field is edited, then its tag changes to 'معدّل عن السجل'.

requirements.statement: The system shall collect the registration field set with required-field validation, adapting it for individuals.
acceptance_criteria: Given an empty required field, when submitting, then the browser blocks submission.
Given type 'فرد', then only personal fields are displayed.

requirements.statement: The system shall verify email, entity phone and delegate mobile by one-time code before submission.
acceptance_criteria: Given an unverified mobile, when submitting, then a toast 'تحقق أولاً من: …' appears.
Given a wrong code, when confirming, then 'الرمز غير صحيح' is shown.

requirements.statement: The system shall submit the registration as a pending request for platform review and confirm it to the user.
acceptance_criteria: Given a valid form, when submitted, then a pending registration exists and the confirmation card is shown.
Given a database error, then a toast shows the error and the form stays.

requirements.statement: The system shall let a user of a registered entity verify affiliation with a code sent to the current delegate.
acceptance_criteria: Given a registered entity with a delegate, when the correct code is entered, then 'تم التحقق من صلتك بالجهة' appears.
Given a wrong code, then a toast error appears.

requirements.statement: The system shall accept a delegate-change request (new delegate name, national ID, mobile, reason) for platform review.
acceptance_criteria: Given all four fields, when submitted, then 'أُرسل طلب تغيير المفوض' is shown.
Given an empty field, then the browser blocks submission.

requirements.statement: The system shall create a pending team-join request linked to the entity when a user successfully verifies affiliation through the delegate.
acceptance_criteria: Given successful delegate verification, when the user signs in, then a join request is visible to the delegate.
Given the delegate rejects, then the user is notified.

requirements.statement: The system shall resolve an invitation by its token and show an invalid-link message when not found.
acceptance_criteria: Given an unknown token, then 'رابط الدعوة غير صالح' is shown.
Given a valid token, then the invited entity name and opportunity are shown.

requirements.statement: The system shall record the first opening of an invitation.
acceptance_criteria: Given status 'sent', when the page loads, then status becomes 'opened'.
Given status 'opened', then it is unchanged.

requirements.statement: The system shall display the invited opportunity's kind, ceiling, closing date, duration, description, scope and deliverables.
acceptance_criteria: Given an RFP with scope and deliverables, then both sections are shown.
Given no duration, then the duration label is hidden.

requirements.statement: The system shall let an invited partner proceed to the application for the invited program.
acceptance_criteria: Given an active account, when 'الانتقال للتقديم' is clicked, then the portal opens with the program's application.
Given status 'applied', then a 'track from portal' message replaces the actions.

requirements.statement: The system shall activate an inactive partner account from the invitation before proceeding.
acceptance_criteria: Given an inactive account, when the form is submitted, then the account becomes active and the portal opens.
Given a missing field, then the browser blocks submission.

requirements.statement: The system shall let an invited partner decline an invitation.
acceptance_criteria: Given an open invitation, when 'اعتذار' is clicked, then status becomes 'declined'.
Given a declined invitation on reload, then only the declined message is shown.

requirements.statement: The system shall open global search from a header button or Ctrl/Cmd+K.
acceptance_criteria: Given any shell page, when Ctrl+K is pressed, then the search dialog toggles.
Given the dialog, when Esc is pressed, then it closes.

requirements.statement: The system shall search partners, applications, projects/initiatives, payments, programs, plans and staff within the current tenant.
acceptance_criteria: Given 'سند', when typed, then partners named 'جمعية سند…' appear under 'الجهات الشريكة'.
Given a 1-character term, then 'اكتب حرفين على الأقل' is shown.

requirements.statement: The system shall match page shortcuts by normalised title and navigate on selection, recording recent items.
acceptance_criteria: Given 'مالية', then the 'المالية' page shortcut is listed.
Given an empty query after previous use, then 'آخر ما فتحته' lists recent items.

requirements.statement: The system shall restrict search results and page shortcuts to entities and pages the user's role may access; applicants shall only find their own organization's records.
acceptance_criteria: Given an applicant, when searching another partner's name, then no result is returned.
Given a reviewer, then '/admin' is not offered as a shortcut.

requirements.statement: The system shall offer a light/dark theme toggle persisted on the device and applied before first paint.
acceptance_criteria: Given dark selected, when reloading, then the page renders dark without flashing light.
Given no stored choice and OS dark mode, then dark is used.

requirements.statement: The system shall let the user choose a colour palette (clay default, teal, lavender) stored on the device.
acceptance_criteria: Given 'أخضر مائي' is chosen, then the UI switches palette immediately and after reload.
Given 'طيني', then the data-palette attribute is removed.

requirements.statement: The system shall render the application in Arabic, right-to-left, with portaled menus and dialogs following RTL.
acceptance_criteria: Given any dropdown or dialog, when opened, then its content aligns right-to-left.
Given the document, then lang='ar' and dir='rtl'.

requirements.statement: The system shall display all numbers with Western digits (0-9) without altering form inputs or exported data.
acceptance_criteria: Given an amount, then it renders like '1,250,000 ر.س' with Western digits.
Given a textarea containing Eastern digits, then its value is not changed.

requirements.statement: The system shall provide the AI Copilot to non-applicant personas in an expandable side panel.
acceptance_criteria: Given an applicant persona, then the Copilot button is not rendered.
Given a staff persona, when the expand icon is clicked, then the panel widens.

requirements.statement: The system shall offer suggested prompts based on the current section.
acceptance_criteria: Given /finance with an empty chat, then prompts about due payments are shown.
Given a prompt is clicked, then it is sent as a message.

requirements.statement: The system shall authenticate Copilot requests and answer using read-only tools over the tenant's data.
acceptance_criteria: Given no token, when posting to /api/chat, then 401 is returned.
Given 'ما الطلبات التي تنتظر قراراً؟', then the answer is based on list_applications results.

requirements.statement: The system shall present any requested change as a proposed-action card linking to the page where the user confirms it.
acceptance_criteria: Given 'اعتمد الدفعة X', then a card links to the relevant page and no data changes.
Given the card link is clicked, then the panel closes and the page opens.

requirements.statement: The system shall keep the conversation per persona on the device and allow stopping a response and starting a new conversation.
acceptance_criteria: Given a reload, when the panel reopens, then previous messages for that persona are shown.
Given 'محادثة جديدة', then messages are cleared.

requirements.statement: The system shall derive the Copilot's tenant scope from the authenticated user on the server and log each request for audit.
acceptance_criteria: Given a body with another tenant's id, then results remain limited to the caller's tenant.
Given any Copilot call, then an audit record with user, time and tools used exists.

requirements.statement: The system shall show page-specific demo walkthrough steps in a help panel.
acceptance_criteria: Given /tasks, when the guide opens, then 'وضع التركيز' and 'المهام المتخطاة' steps are listed.
Given a page without a guide, then the generic hint is shown.

requirements.statement: The system shall identify the pending payment step on a project and offer to switch to the responsible persona.
acceptance_criteria: Given a payment awaiting receipt, then the guide proposes the beneficiary's applicant persona.
Given all payments paid, then 'كل الدفعات مكتملة' is shown.

requirements.statement: The system shall provide advance, undo and reset controls that apply predefined scenario states to the demo project.
acceptance_criteria: Given step 4, when 'تقدّم' is clicked, then the disbursement order exists and the bar shows step 5 of 7.
Given any step, when 'تصفير' is clicked, then the project returns to its initial state.

requirements.statement: The system shall present the workshop deck with slide navigation, progress, keyboard shortcuts and fullscreen.
acceptance_criteria: Given slide 1, when space is pressed, then slide 2 shows and progress updates.
Given F, then the deck enters fullscreen.

requirements.statement: The system shall capture notes per session in three categories and aggregate them on the summary slide.
acceptance_criteria: Given a note in session 3 'challenges', then the summary slide lists it under 'تحديات ومتطلبات' with the session title.
Given a reload on the same device, then notes persist.

requirements.statement: The system shall allow exporting or sharing workshop notes.
acceptance_criteria: Given notes, when 'export' is chosen, then a document with all sessions' notes downloads.
Given another facilitator device, then shared notes are visible.

requirements.statement: The system shall provide a reusable data table with free-text search, column visibility, pagination and row navigation.
acceptance_criteria: Given 40 rows and size 15, then 3 pages are available.
Given a search term, then only rows whose exported values contain it are shown and paging resets to page 1.

requirements.statement: The system shall export the filtered table to XLSX and CSV.
acceptance_criteria: Given a filter leaving 22 rows across 2 pages, when exporting CSV, then the file has 22 data rows.
Given a hidden column, then it is not exported.

requirements.statement: The system shall let each user pin the current view as their default and restore the original.
acceptance_criteria: Given hidden columns changed, when 'حفظ كعرض افتراضي' is chosen, then the next visit restores them.
Given a saved view, when 'استعادة العرض الأصلي' is chosen, then defaults return.

requirements.statement: The system shall group secondary filters behind a 'تصفية' popover showing the active count and removable chips.
acceptance_criteria: Given two active secondary filters, then the button shows 2 and two chips appear.
Given a chip's ×, then that filter clears.

requirements.statement: The system shall show a page-shaped loading skeleton that switches to an error message with retry when an active query fails.
acceptance_criteria: Given a failing query, then 'تعذّر تحميل البيانات' with 'إعادة المحاولة' is shown.
Given retry succeeds, then the page renders.

requirements.statement: The system shall show a 404 page for unknown routes and an error page with retry and home actions for uncaught errors, reporting them to telemetry.
acceptance_criteria: Given /unknown, then 'الصفحة غير موجودة' with 'العودة للرئيسية' is shown.
Given a render error, when 'حاول مجدداً' is clicked, then the route reloads.

requirements.statement: The system shall provide a standard page container and page header with optional concept help and actions.
acceptance_criteria: Given PageHeader with info='plan', then an info icon opens the plan concept.
Given actions, then they render aligned at the end of the header.

requirements.statement: The system shall provide a guided 'smart path' dialog that walks the user through typed steps before a final action.
acceptance_criteria: Given a 3-step flow, when on step 1, then later steps cannot be jumped to.
Given canNext=false, then the next/finish button is disabled.

requirements.statement: The system shall explain key domain concepts in place through info popovers.
acceptance_criteria: Given the info icon next to 'الخطة السنوية', then its definition and example are shown.
Given a concept with empty example, then no example line is shown.

requirements.statement: The system shall split long entry dialogs into steps of at most three fields automatically unless opted out.
acceptance_criteria: Given a dialog with 7 fields, then it shows 3 steps with the submit button on the last.
Given autoSteps={false}, then all fields show at once.

requirements.statement: The system shall provide link tabs that group related pages under one sidebar entry.
acceptance_criteria: Given /contracts, then 'العقود' is active within PROJECT_TABS.
Given /settings without tab, then the first settings tab for the role is active.

requirements.statement: The system shall provide KPI cards that can act as accessible table filters, and standard Pill, Field and StageTracker display elements.
acceptance_criteria: Given a clickable StatCard, when Enter is pressed, then its filter applies and the card shows an active ring.
Given Field value 0, then nothing renders.

stories.story: As any user, I want the platform to establish my authenticated session before showing data so that records are never readable anonymously.
acceptance_criteria: Given no session, When the app loads, Then 'جارٍ التحميل…' shows until the session exists.
Given a valid session, When a server function is called, Then it runs with the caller's token.
Given a call without token, When a protected server function runs, Then it fails 'Unauthorized'.

stories.story: As a returning user, I want to sign in from a login page so that I reach my workspace.
acceptance_criteria: Given the login page, When the form is submitted, Then the user lands on ROLE_HOME of the active persona.
Given required fields are empty, When submitting, Then the browser blocks submission.

stories.story: As a platform administrator, I want each person to sign in with individual credentials and no demo shortcuts in production so that every action is attributable.
acceptance_criteria: Given two users, When each signs in, Then audit records show their own identity.
Given a production build, When any page loads, Then no persona switcher, demo guide or demo bar is visible.

stories.story: As a tenant administrator, I want data access enforced by tenant and role on the server so that users cannot see or change data outside their remit.
acceptance_criteria: Given a reviewer, When attempting to update a payment via API, Then the request is rejected.
Given a user of tenant A, When listing applications, Then no tenant B rows are returned.

stories.story: As a demo presenter, I want to switch between personas so that I can show each role's experience from one browser.
acceptance_criteria: Given the persona menu, When 'مدير المنح' persona is selected, Then the sidebar shows the grants-manager items and /tasks opens.
Given a reload, When the app starts, Then the same persona is active.

stories.story: As a staff user, I want a sidebar showing only my role's sections with pending-work badges so that I can go straight to my work.
acceptance_criteria: Given role finance, When the shell renders, Then items are Data & reports, Annual plan, My tasks, Projects.
Given 2 open payment tasks, When rendered, Then 'المشاريع' shows badge 2.

stories.story: As an applicant or mobile user, I want a layout suited to my context (header-only portal layout; navigation drawer on phones) so that the interface stays usable.
acceptance_criteria: Given an applicant persona, When any page renders, Then no sidebar is shown.
Given a phone viewport, When the menu is tapped, Then the role navigation opens in a drawer from the right.

stories.story: As a platform administrator, I want platform-level pages and settings tabs hidden from tenant users so that tenant staff only manage their own organization.
acceptance_criteria: Given a grants_manager, When opening /admin, Then 'هذه الصفحة خاصة بإدارة المنصة' is shown.
Given admin, When opening Settings, Then 'فريق العمل' tab is not shown.

stories.story: As a prospective applicant, I want to see the platform's purpose and currently active grant programs so that I can decide to apply or register.
acceptance_criteria: Given active programs exist, When the landing loads, Then each shows title, description, budget and deadline.
Given 'تصفح برامج المنح', When clicked, Then /portal opens.

stories.story: As a partner representative, I want to choose my entity type and check my license/ID so that I know whether my entity is already registered.
acceptance_criteria: Given license 1234, When checked, Then '«…» مسجلة مسبقاً' with masked delegates appears.
Given a pending license, When checked, Then the masked applicant name and mobile are shown.

stories.story: As a representative of a new entity, I want the form prefilled from the official registry and to submit it for review so that registration is fast and accurate.
acceptance_criteria: Given license 7781, When looked up, Then registry fields are prefilled and tagged 'من السجل'.
Given a complete verified form, When submitted, Then 'أُرسل الطلب للتدقيق' is shown and a pending registration exists.

stories.story: As a partner representative, I want to confirm my email and mobile numbers with a one-time code so that the platform can trust the contact channels.
acceptance_criteria: Given an unverified mobile, When submitting, Then 'تحقق أولاً من: جوال المفوض' appears.
Given the correct code, When confirming, Then the field shows a verified badge.

stories.role: Staff member of a registered partner

rules.rule: Every page renders only after an authenticated Supabase session exists; if none, the client signs into (or signs up) one shared demo account before rendering.
The active persona is chosen client-side and persisted in browser storage (key 'grants-poc-persona'); if none is stored, the first persona (ordered by role, then name) is used.
Each role has a fixed sidebar set (NAV_BY_ROLE) and a home route (ROLE_HOME); switching persona navigates to the role home.
The sidebar is hidden on public pages ('/', '/login', '/register-tenant') and for the applicant role, which uses a header-only layout.
/admin is available only to the 'admin' role; other roles see a message pointing to Settings > Team.
/portal content is available only to the 'applicant' role; other roles are asked to switch persona.
Settings section tabs flagged platformOnly are shown only to admin; tabs flagged tenantOnly are hidden from admin.
The AI Copilot is not available to applicant personas.
The Copilot never writes data: it uses read-only query tools and returns any change as a 'propose_action' link card that the employee confirms on the real page.
The Copilot answers in Arabic plain text with Western digits and SAR amounts, uses tools instead of inventing figures, and is limited to 6 model/tool steps per answer.
Global search runs only for terms of at least 2 characters, debounced 250 ms, scoped to the current persona's tenant, returning at most 5 hits per entity type.
Search matching treats hamza variants of alef, taa marbuta/haa, alef maqsura/yaa and Eastern/Western digits as equivalent.
The recent-items list keeps the last 6 opened results, de-duplicated by link.
Self-registration offers only applicant types flagged for the portal and not closed by the tenant; government entities are internal-only.
License lookup precedence: an existing beneficiary with that license → 'registered'; else a pending registration → 'pending'; else 'new' (with registry prefill when found).
Email, entity phone and delegate mobile must be OTP-verified when filled before a registration can be submitted.

A registration is stored as a pending request with per-field source (registry / registry_edited / manual) and decision 'pending'; the partner organization is created only when the platform approves it (see BEN).
Delegate identity shown to anonymous users is masked: mobile shows only the last 4 digits; name shows initials plus the first 3 letters of the family name.
For the 'individual' type, organization-only fields (entity type, unified number, classification, entity phone, delegate name/ID) are hidden and labels are personalised.
An invitation is marked 'opened' only when its status is still 'sent'; accept/decline set 'applied'/'declined' with a response timestamp.
Proceeding from an invitation for an inactive partner account activates the account (account_status='active', activated_at).
Saved views store only values the user explicitly pins (e.g. hidden columns, page size, page filters) per persona and view key; search text and page number are never saved.
List exports contain only visible columns that define an export value, for all filtered rows (not just the current page); CSV is UTF-8 with BOM, XLSX is right-to-left.
Rendered labels and visible attributes are normalised to Western digits; inputs, textareas, code and [data-no-convert] are excluded; formatters use the '-u-nu-latn' locale extension.
The Field display component hides empty, '—' and zero values.

Sidebar badges count open tasks from the same source as 'My tasks': total for /tasks, application tasks for /reviewer, payment tasks for /projects and /finance; manual tasks count only if assigned to or attended by the current persona.
Demo controls appear only on the designated demo project; step k moves the scenario from state k to k+1 across 7 steps; reset returns to state 0.
A stored theme preference overrides the operating-system colour-scheme preference and is applied before hydration.
Workshop notes autosave to the presenting device; deck keyboard shortcuts are ignored while typing in a note.
In production, every request must be authorised server-side by the authenticated user's tenant and role, not by a client-selected persona.

issues.description: Shared demo account: hard-coded e-mail/password in the client bundle with a sign-up fallback; every visitor is silently authenticated as the same user, so 'signed-in only' RLS is effectively public access and no action is attributable to a person.
issues.recommendation: Replace with per-user authentication (FR-PLT-004); remove credentials from source; rotate the demo account password.

issues.description: RLS policies grant any authenticated user full SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE on every public table and the attachments bucket; no tenant isolation, no role checks.
issues.recommendation: Tenant- and permission-scoped policies; append-only audit tables; storage paths scoped by tenant (FR-PLT-005).

issues.description: Permissions are UI-only: the persona is chosen client-side (localStorage) so anyone can become 'admin'; only /admin and /portal have page gates; every other route is reachable by URL; the Settings › Roles permission matrix is declarative and enforced nowhere.
issues.recommendation: Server-side authorization, route guards (beforeLoad) driven by the authenticated user's permissions.

issues.description: Applicant personas get Global Search in their header, which queries tenant-wide partners, applications, payments and staff — exposing other partners' data to an external user.
issues.recommendation: Hide or scope search for applicants to their own organization (FR-PLT-037).

issues.description: Copilot tenant scope comes from the client request body (tenantId); omitted or forged values widen the scope; list_plan_levels is never tenant-scoped; no audit log or rate limit; reasoning is streamed to the client.
issues.recommendation: Derive tenant/role from the token server-side; scope every tool; log calls; quotas (FR-PLT-047).

issues.description: Login is cosmetic: credentials are ignored and any pointer-down autofills 'demo@minah.sa / Demo1234', which is not even the account actually used by DemoSession.
issues.recommendation: Implement real sign-in; remove autofill.

issues.description: Shared query hooks and the persona list load rows of all tenants without a tenant filter; the persona switcher lists personas from every tenant.
issues.recommendation: Filter by the user's tenant in queries and RLS.

issues.description: Terminology/route mismatch: route '/register-tenant' and CTAs 'سجّل جهتك كمانحة' (register as donor) / 'جهة مانحة جديدة؟' lead to a page that registers partner (beneficiary) organizations; registration writes to a hard-coded TENANT_ID.
issues.recommendation: Rename route/labels to partner registration; resolve tenant from context (domain/invitation); decide whether donor (tenant) self-onboarding exists (OQ-PLT-12).

issues.description: OTP codes are generated with Math.random in the browser and displayed on screen; verification is client-side only, so verification can be bypassed and is not recorded.
issues.recommendation: Server-generated OTP via SMS/e-mail provider, expiry, attempt limits, verification stored with the registration.

issues.description: Successful delegate verification persists nothing: the user is told the delegate will add them, but no join request is created.
issues.recommendation: Create a pending membership/join request (FR-PLT-027).

issues.description: Invitation activation form has hard-coded demo defaults (name, national ID, password 'demo1234') and stores none of the entered values; token links have no expiry and no check that the program is still open; the invite page renders inside whatever persona's shell is active (staff sidebar for the default admin).
issues.recommendation: Persist delegate identity (ideally via national SSO), add expiry/open-window checks, treat /invite as a public layout.

issues.description: Declining an invitation does not refresh the query; the actions remain visible until reload.
issues.recommendation: Invalidate the invite query after decline.

issues.description: Role home inconsistencies: committee_secretary's home is /analytics, which is not in its sidebar; admin's home is /tasks while the brand logo sends admin to /analytics.
issues.recommendation: Align ROLE_HOME with NAV_BY_ROLE (OQ-PLT-13).

issues.description: Landing lists programs with status 'active' regardless of 'published' and open window (isPeriodOpen not applied), across all tenants, and shows the legacy 'deadline' field instead of close_at; 'Apply now' sends visitors to /portal, which for the default non-applicant persona only says 'switch persona'.
issues.recommendation: Use isPeriodOpen and close_at; route visitors to registration/login when not an applicant.

issues.description: Demo controls write directly to project/payment tables bypassing workflow/payment libraries, use payment status 'pending' (not in PAYMENT_STATUS_LABELS), are visible to every role, and keep the step pointer per device so it can desync from the database.
issues.recommendation: Keep demo-only behind a flag; derive step from DB state; align status values.

issues.description: Demo guide maps 'awaiting_approval' payments to grants_manager only, whereas the approval chain is project_manager → grants_manager → ceo.
issues.recommendation: Derive the responsible role from approval_step (see FIN).

issues.description: Two different StatCard components exist (common.tsx with tone/onClick and StatCard.tsx without).
issues.recommendation: Consolidate into one shared component.

issues.description: StageTracker hard-codes three stages (استقبال، دراسة، اعتماد) while workflow stages are configurable per program/template.
issues.recommendation: Render stages from workflow_stages (see PRG/REV).

issues.description: Field hides zero values, so legitimate zeros (e.g. 0 SAR spent, 0%) disappear.
issues.recommendation: Hide only null/empty; let callers opt-in to hiding zero.

issues.description: LatinDigits starts after a 1 s delay and observes the whole DOM, causing a flash of Eastern digits and runtime cost.
issues.recommendation: Format at source (-u-nu-latn) and keep the observer only as a fallback.

issues.description: The server-side error page is in English and LTR while the product is Arabic RTL.
issues.recommendation: Localise the SSR error page.

issues.description: Browser storage holds potentially sensitive data: Copilot transcripts per persona, recent-search items (one key shared by all personas on the device), workshop notes.
issues.recommendation: Store server-side per user or clear on sign-out; key recent items per user.

issues.description: Global-search page shortcuts are not filtered by role (e.g. /admin, /finance offered to reviewers).
issues.recommendation: Filter shortcuts by role permissions.

issues.description: Product naming is inconsistent: 'منصة منح' (page titles), 'مانح' (workshop deck), Noura Al-Mallahi Foundation logo in the shell, repository 'manih', demo e-mail domain 'minah.sa'.
issues.recommendation: Confirm product and brand names (OQ-PLT-15).

issues.description: Authenticated server functions resolve userId to the shared demo account, and audit fields (changed_by, actor_id, sent_by) take persona ids supplied by the client — audit trails are not trustworthy.
issues.recommendation: Derive actor from the token on the server (FR-PLT-004/005).

issues.description: Unused navigation definitions (ALL.finance, ALL.reports) and a header label 'الإعدادات' on /admin while the page is titled 'بوابة الآدمن' in metadata.
issues.recommendation: Clean up; align titles.

issues.description: Workshop deck content (client names, agenda times, questions) is hard-coded; notes cannot be exported or shared between facilitators.
issues.recommendation: Externalise content; add export (FR-PLT-053) or remove after the workshop.

issues.description: Landing page queries and other list queries show no error UI (failures render empty lists).
issues.recommendation: Use PageSkeleton error pattern.

open_questions.question: Which identity provider(s) will production use (e.g. national SSO such as Nafath for partner delegates, e-mail/password, corporate SSO for staff)? Is MFA required for any role?
Can one person hold several roles or organization memberships at once (persona_memberships / beneficiary_memberships), and how is the active role chosen in production?
Is any persona-switching/impersonation capability needed in production (e.g. support), or is it removed entirely?
Is the product a multi-tenant SaaS operated by a platform admin, or a single-donor deployment? What exactly may the 'admin' role see across tenants?
Should partner (applicant) users have global search, and over which records?
Copilot: approved LLM provider and data-residency constraints, roles allowed, conversation retention/logging, and per-user quotas?
Must the landing page be truly public (no session), and should it list only published, open opportunities — of which tenant(s)?
Registry and OTP integration: which registry API (e.g. National Center for Non-Profit Sector) per applicant type, which SMS/e-mail provider, code length/expiry/attempt limits?
Invitation policy: link expiry, resend, who may activate the account, and what identity proof is required on activation?
Should theme/palette/saved views be per user (server-side) or per device; is there organization-level branding?
Are the demo guide, demo controls and workshop deck retained after the analysis phase (e.g. as a training mode) or removed?
Is self-service onboarding of donor organizations (tenants) in scope, or only partner registration? (Route is named register-tenant.)
What should be the home page and dashboard access of the committee secretary (home is /analytics but it is not in its sidebar)?
Which roles may export lists to Excel/CSV, and are exports to be logged or watermarked?
What is the official product name and branding (منصة منح / مانح / Manih) and whose logo appears in the shell?
